{{nihongo|'''Kita Shrine'''|気多神社 (沼津市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Kita Shrine''' (きたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Uchiura Mitsu, {{ill|Numazu|Q241037|qid=Q241037}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4403277 気多神社] - 静岡県神社庁</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined very close to the front of Uchiura Port in the Mitsu district on the northern coast of Uchiura Bay. Raigōji Temple stands immediately to the south, and the central trailhead of the hiking course for {{ill|Mount Hottanjō|Q11579067|qid=Q11579067}} runs between them.

It is said to have been founded in {{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}} (Jōgan 1), and is treated as a candidate shrine (ronsha) for the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} '''Ametsuseketachi-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (あめつせけたちのみことじんじゃ) (and also Ida Shrine)<ref name="yuisho">境内由緒書</ref><ref name="city">[https://www.city.numazu.shizuoka.jp/kurashi/kyoiku/kyoiku/bunka/doc/b_machiarukimap_r4_uchiura.pdf 文化財まちあるきマップ 内浦編] - 沼津市</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140222-04.html 気多神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref>.

The enshrined deity is Okinagatarashihime-no-Mikoto, interpreted as Empress Jingū ({{ill|Empress Jingū|ar|الإمبراطورة جينغو|arz|الامبراطوره جينجو|az|Cinqu|bcl|Empress Jingū|ca|Jingu|cs|Džingú|de|Jingū|es|Jingū|eu|Jingū enperatriza|fa|امپراتریس جینگو|fr|Jingū|hr|Jingū (japanska carica)|hu|Dzsingú japán császárnő|id|Permaisuri Jingū|it|Jingū|ja|神功皇后|ka|ძინგუ|ko|진구 황후|nl|Jingu|pl|Jingū|pt|Jingu|ru|Императрица Дзингу|sh|Carica Jingū|si|ජින්ගූ අධිරාජිනිය|simple|Empress Jingū|sl|Cesarica Džingu|sv|Jingu Kogo|te|రాణి జింగూ|th|จักรพรรดินีจิงงู|tl|Emperatris Jingū|tr|Jingū (imparatoriçe)|uk|Імператриця Дзінґу|uz|Imperator Jingū|vi|Thiên hoàng Jingū|zh|神功皇后|zh_min_nan|Sîn-kong Hông-hō͘|zh_yue|神功皇后|qid=Q232803}}), mother of Homuda Tennō ({{ill|Emperor Ōjin|ar|الإمبراطور أوجين|arz|الامبراطور اوجين|azb|اوجین (ایمپیراتور)|bn|সম্রাট ওজিন|cs|Ódžin|de|Ōjin|es|Ōjin Tennō|eu|Ōjin enperadorea|fa|امپراتور اوجین|fi|Ōjin|fr|Ōjin|hr|Ōjin|id|Kaisar Ōjin|it|Ōjin|ja|応神天皇|ka|ოძინი|ko|오진 천황|nl|Ojin|pl|Ōjin|pt|Ojin|ru|Император Одзин|sh|Car Ōjin|simple|Emperor Ōjin|sl|Cesar Odžin|sv|Ojin|th|จักรพรรดิโอจิง|tl|Emperador Ōjin|tr|Ōjin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Одзін|uz|Imperator Ōjin|vi|Thiên hoàng Ōjin|yo|Emperor Ōjin|zh|应神天皇|zh_min_nan|Ôzin Thian-hông|zh_yue|應神天皇|qid=Q317997}}), who is {{ill|Hachiman|Q261637|qid=Q261637}}<ref name="yuisho"/><ref name="city"/><ref name="engi"/>.
